gloss: to overflow; to be filled with; to brim with

definitions.explanation: For liquid or contents to exceed a container's capacity and spill out.

definitions.gloss: to be filled with; to brim with
definitions.explanation: To be full of an emotion, quality, or abundance of something.

examples.japanese: お{風呂|ふろ}のお{湯|ゆ}が{溢|あふ}れた。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{自信|じしん}に{溢|あふ}れている。
{街|まち}には{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{溢|あふ}れていた。
examples.english: The town was overflowing with tourists.

notes:
{溢|あふ}れる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) describing overflow or abundance.

ASPECT (ている):
{溢|あふ}れている indicates something is currently overflowing or full of something.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [container]から[liquid]が{溢|あふ}れる — [liquid] overflows from [container]
- [quality]に{溢|あふ}れる — to be full of [quality]
- [place]に[things]が{溢|あふ}れる — [place] is overflowing with [things]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {涙|なみだ}が{溢|あふ}れる (tears overflow)
- {愛情|あいじょう}に{溢|あふ}れる (full of affection)
- {活気|かっき}に{溢|あふ}れる (full of vitality)
- {笑顔|えがお}に{溢|あふ}れる (full of smiles)

OFTEN WRITTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as あふれる rather than {溢|あふ}れる due to the kanji's complexity.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {零|こぼ}れる: to spill (smaller amounts, drops)
- {溢|あふ}れる: to overflow (larger amounts, abundance)
